deliberately_unmapped.why: A.SCXP has no attribute for the called-cell count. It is worth proposing as a schema addition, but that is an Attribute API decision, not a mapping one.

The contract test can only check that a rule's target attribute exists, not that its raw `from` key is a real MultiQC column; every raw key guessed this way in the rnaseq map turned out wrong against a real run (the real convention is <module>-<metric>, not Module_metric), and for rnaseq the fastqc read-count keys additionally turned out to live only on per-read rows, never the sample row. There is no scrnaseq fixture here to check a guess against, so the read-count key is deliberately left unmapped: the first real scrnaseq run will surface the true key through the approval queue, which is the designed mechanism for exactly this case.
